subject.title: Feature request: Mid-stream message injection (soft steer)

question: Should OpenClaw add true soft-steer semantics beyond current boundary steering, and should that be an opt-in queue mode or a change to existing `steer` behavior?
rationale: This changes when active runs may be interrupted, how partial output and tool results are preserved, and which session context receives injected input; current docs intentionally separate boundary steering from interrupt behavior.

options.title: Design Opt-In Soft Steer
options.body: Add a new mode or policy for abort/capture/inject/resume semantics with tests across streaming, tools, transcript state, fallback, and provider runtimes.

options.title: Keep Boundary Steering Only
options.body: Keep the current contract and use narrower issues such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/48003 for delivery bugs within boundary steering.

options.title: Change Steer Globally
options.body: Make existing `steer` more aggressive by default, accepting compatibility risk for users who expect current tool-boundary behavior.

recommendation.title: Design Opt-In Soft Steer
recommendation.body: Add a new mode or policy for abort/capture/inject/resume semantics with tests across streaming, tools, transcript state, fallback, and provider runtimes.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is already in the issue discussion and has the strongest combined product-review and original steering-history signal.
